cards.text: Have you ever lost something you're still holding?
I work the night lost-property desk, and a soaked stranger handed in my keys.
Mine were still in my pocket, dry, on the same frayed red ribbon.
Next morning, they slipped through a grate on the river bridge.
Now he comes every night with something of mine, the day before I lose it.
My glasses. My phone, still ringing. Last night, the coat I'm wearing.
Tonight he just stood at my desk, river water pooling around his shoes.
Then he slid my staff badge across the desk.
